reviews.title: Very good monitor, definitely worth the price.
reviews.comment:
Very good monitor, definitely worth the price. The picture quality and colors are great, and the mount is solid.
The only issue is that it should come with a set of universal USB cables. I’m currently using it for a specific project, which required me to buy a particular cable. However, sometimes I would like to connect my laptop to it, but I’m still not sure which type of USB port or cable I need.
Additionally, I had to purchase another USB cable to use it with my specific PC.
reviews.author: Alberto Joseph Baltazar

reviews.title: 49" monitor great buy
reviews.comment: Great monitor. I use it for sim racing and all in have to say is wow. Ive had it for 3 weeks now and extremely happy with this monitor. The 165hrz is beautiful. I would definitely recommend this monitor. Also I got a 3 yr warranty with it. You can't go wrong and price is very good.
reviews.author: Jessica Gardner

reviews.title: Very pleased, all 'round
reviews.comment: The screw heads are kind of soft, and fail. -0.2 stars, but rounds up to a five. PERFECT monitor for 3d modeling software. Plenty of real estate for the central work area and the associated controls on the side. Nice, clear, bright display (I'm toning down the brightness, next). I don't know the refresh rate and don't feel like looking at the specs, so I can't comment on gaming applications. A comment on the stand, it's not adjustable. I'll see if I can find a wall mount for the four screw-mounts, 80mm apart. My existing mount was 100mm -- more standard. Bizarre statements in the instructions, as is par for the course, but irrelevant. I am 0% unhappy with my purchase. Makes me really look forward to these li'l guys putting out that Type 004 carrier.
reviews.author: Terugtrekkende-Zeug

reviews.title: Beautiful 200hz display
reviews.comment: Beautiful display and clear picture despite its size you'd never think it was a 200hz monitor display and for its price it is a great deal not even my much bigger monitor hits 200hz so that alone is impressive in  it self. This monitor is the greatest bang for your buck you can buy at this price. It is bright and has very nice smooth edges with a nice texture and it doesn't feel cheap though the stand is a bit mid and isn't as adjustable as I'd like but it's still great if you're a gamer because it has freesync and hdr for vivid colors and brightness. For $100 you can't get better at this price with all the features packed into this display its honestly impressive.
reviews.author: Joseph Colascione Jr

reviews.title: Amazing monitor for a great price
reviews.comment: I enjoy gaming and spend a bit on the computer for my job so I wanted a good quality monitor for a good price. When I found this monitor I had to buy it twice! The color accuracy is decent but for this price, the screen size, response time, and durability has been amazing. I’ve had issues with the screen turning off a few times but I just switch the cords. Again for the price I got them at, I do not regret my decision.
reviews.author: Daryl Vargas
